item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.desc: An ancient seal carrying the decree and ashes of a dynasty. Its wearer will slowly bear 9 curses.
item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.hint_: Hold Shift to view curse details
Hold Ctrl to view the story
item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.curse: Curse I: Edict of the Twin Gods
-> Every %s minutes, gain 1 random negative effect for %s seconds at levels %s to %s.
-> Continuously removes %s Luck. Every %s minutes, there is a %s chance to summon 1 hostile mob within %s blocks.
Curse III: Tax of the Royal Name
-> Experience from any kill becomes %s, enchanting cost becomes %s times, and anvil cost becomes %s times.
Curse IV: Contract of the Two Lands
-> Villager and wandering trader prices increase by %s.
Curse V: Scale of the Innocent

-> Each innocent kill adds 1 King's Guilt. At %s, inventory is sealed for %s minutes and %s lightning strikes descend. After inversion, hostile kills build Mercy, and 1299 Mercy stores one death reversal.
-> After %s minutes, the main hand is sealed for %s minutes. After that, 1 random item is locked every %s minutes for %s minutes.
Curse VII: Judgment of the End
-> While in the End, Weakness %s is always active.
-> After the first Nether entry, attacks on monsters have a %s chance to rebound, dealing %s extra damage to you.
-> Each death removes 2 hunger points and creates 1 Satiety Crystal above the death site. Picking it up returns the lost hunger.
item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.story: The Seal of Kadesh does not preserve a victory. It seals the price a dynasty refused to confess between gold and stone.
It is like a regent's crown that never leaves the brow, writing commands for its bearer without ever giving a reason.
Every summoned hostility and every carved scar is its way of singing an old royal name again.
When you believe you merely borrowed an ornament, the seal has already entered your name into its years.
So what it truly binds is not the wrist, but a life standing before the dying embers of power.
item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.nethe: You have stepped there. The curse has taken hold.
You have stepped there. The mark has been inverted.
item.ramesses_curse.hymn_of_the_two_land: A royal disc that can awaken a music relic after one full playback.
item.ramesses_curse.resonant_scarab.desc: It answers no noise, only the final turn of an old royal hymn.
item.ramesses_curse.resonant_scarab.effe: -When the nearby casket-song finishes, the scarab stirs from its sleep.
-Once removed, the echo scatters and the scarab falls silent again.
item.ramesses_curse.resonant_scarab.awak: -The old hymn is awake: Resistance, +20% attack, +15% armor, +3 reach.
item.ramesses_curse.heart_of_duat.skill_: -Active: When hostile entities within 16 blocks reach 6 or more, grant Strength III and highlight hostile entities.
-Passive: While in deserts or badlands, grant Luck II and +5 entity reach.
item.ramesses_curse.ember_of_duat.riddle: It will not answer a right-click before the inscription is solved.
A single-use rite of pardon that burns away part of the King's Guilt.

screen.ramesses_curse.curse_5_choice.bod: The twin gods offer one final fork in the dream. Whichever path you choose, there is no return.
Inversion rewrites the Scale of the Innocent into Mercy; refusal preserves the old King's Guilt judgment.

jei.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.line1: A dynastic relic that binds itself to the wearer.
jei.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.line2: Unlocks the curse-centered core of the mod.
jei.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.line3: Its curses reshape hunger, combat, trade, and survival.

Consumes itself when its pardon is invoked.
jei.ramesses_curse.satiety_crystal.line1: A crystal that stores hunger debt until reclaimed.
jei.ramesses_curse.satiety_crystal.line2: Recovering it returns what it has taken.
jei.ramesses_curse.ember_of_duat.line1: Found only in Nether containers such as fortress chests and bastion stores.
jei.ramesses_curse.ember_of_duat.line2: A ritual-grade cinder steeped in Nether heat and graveweight.
jei.ramesses_curse.ember_of_duat.line3: A rare cursed material prized for forbidden rites.
jei.ramesses_curse.heart_of_duat.line1: A star-fed core condensed from four Embers of Duat.
jei.ramesses_curse.heart_of_duat.line2: A higher ritual material carrying the heat of the underworld.
jei.ramesses_curse.uraeus_necklace.line1: Each strike deepens a single configured curse effect on hostile mobs.
jei.ramesses_curse.uraeus_necklace.line2: At 8 stacks it bursts into heavy execution damage, and rain favors the wearer.
